ans = "Yes"

h, w, n = map(int, input().split())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
a.sort(reverse=True)
l = [[h, w]]

for i in range(n):
    x = 2**a[i]
    y = 2**a[i]

    m = len(l)
    f = 0
    for j in range(m):
        s = l[j][0]
        t = l[j][1]

                l.append(p)

            w2 = s
            h2 = t - y

                q.sort()
                l.append(q)

            f = 1
            break
